description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomFieldDao class within the OrangeHRM application's PIM plugin. It tests CRUD operations and search functionalities related to custom fields, using a test framework with setup routines to populate test data.

classes.name: CustomFieldDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the CustomFieldDao class methods, including retrieval, deletion, search, save, edit, and validity checks for custom fields.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, setting up the CustomFieldDao instance and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldById
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a custom field by ID returns expected attributes.

methods.name: testDeleteCustomField
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple custom fields by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchCustomField
methods.description: Checks search returns correct number of custom fields and confirms object types.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithLimit
methods.description: Ensures search respects the limit parameter.

methods.name: testSaveCustomField
methods.description: Verifies saving a new custom field assigns correct properties and increments field number appropriately.

methods.name: testEditCustomField
methods.description: Tests updating an existing custom field's attributes.

methods.name: testGetSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Checks the count of custom fields matching search criteria.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithScreen
methods.description: Tests filtering custom fields by screen attribute.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithFieldNumbers
methods.description: Tests filtering custom fields by specific field numbers.

methods.name: testIsCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Checks if the system correctly identifies custom fields currently in use.

methods.name: testUpdateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Tests updating employee records if a dropdown value is in use by custom fields.
